items.source: %s has no impacts — it is the bed alone, for the length of the craft.
items.target: %s 沒有打擊感——在整個製造過程中僅有持續基底震動。

items.source:
A bed you feel for the length of a craft, with the profession's own work rhythm struck over it. While a craft is running this replaces |cffffd100Casting texture|r rather than layering with it, so one action is one sensation.

The profession is read from the recipe by id, so it does not depend on your language. Anything that does not resolve still gets a generic work rhythm rather than going quiet.
items.target:
在製造期間持續感受到的基底震動，並疊加各專業自身的敲擊工作節奏。當製造進行時，此震動會取代|cffffd100施法質感|r而非與其疊加，使單一動作對應單一體感。

專業技能是透過配方法術 ID 讀取，因此不受語言影響。任何無法解析的情況仍會獲得通用工作節奏，而非保持靜音。

items.source: CURSOR_CHANGED, with C_Cursor.GetCursorItem() checked only for presence — never read, never compared, so a secret item can't break it (truthiness on a non-secret-boolean is legal). items.source: Reads GetShapeshiftForm()/UPDATE_SHAPESHIFT_FORM, the player's own state — one generic cue for any change, not split by direction, since forms chain (e.g. Bear -> Cat -> Moonkin) without necessarily passing back through no-form in between.
items.target: 讀取玩家自身狀態 GetShapeshiftForm()/UPDATE_SHAPESHIFT_FORM——任何變更皆採用單一通用提示，不區分切換方向，因為形態之間可連續切換（例如：熊形態 -> 獵豹形態 -> 梟獸形態）而不必先切回無形態狀態。

items.source: Reads the skill-up chat feed rather than SKILL_LINES_CHANGED, which also fires for unrelated skill-list changes. Occurrence-only, no text parsing — this says a skill went up, not which one or to what. Deliberately light: early profession levelling fires this constantly.
items.target: 讀取技能提升聊天訊息而非 SKILL_LINES_CHANGED（後者亦會在不相關的技能清單變更時觸發）。僅提示事件發生，無文字解析——這表示有技能提升，但不指明是哪一項或提升至多少。刻意設計得輕微：前期升級專業技能時觸發極為頻繁。

items.source:
Tactile sensations for living in the world of Azeroth:
• |cffffffffLoot Drops & Currency:|r Feel items and gold collected into your bags.
• |cffffffffQuests & Turn-ins:|r Physical confirmation upon accepting and completing objectives.
• |cffffffffProgression:|r Rewarding celebration pulses for leveling up, achievements, and XP gains.
items.target:
漫遊艾澤拉斯世界的觸覺體感：
• |cffffffff掉落物品與貨幣：|r 感受物品與金幣收入背包的觸感。
• |cffffffff任務與回報：|r 接取與完成任務目標時提供實體回饋感。
• |cffffffff角色成長：|r 升級、獲得成就與獲得經驗值時產生獎勵慶祝脈衝。

items.source: The other edge of the same CURSOR_CHANGED transition. Fires whether the item was placed somewhere or the drag was simply cancelled — the event doesn't distinguish, and nothing readable does.
items.target: 同一個 CURSOR_CHANGED 轉換的另一端。無論是物品被放置於某處，還是拖曳動作被單純取消皆會觸發——該事件無法區分，且沒有任何可讀取的資訊能加以分辨。

items.source: The work itself while you craft — a bed for the length of it, with the profession's own rhythm struck on top. A hammer for blacksmithing, a pick for mining, nothing percussive for tailoring or enchanting.
items.target: 製造過程本身的工作體感——在整個過程中持續的基底震動，並疊加各專業自身的敲擊節奏。鍛造是鐵鎚敲擊，採礦是十字鎬敲打，裁縫或附魔則無敲擊衝擊感。

items.source: These strike. The shape and the rate come from the craft — a hammer is slower and heavier than a pick — and the last blow lands on completion.
items.target: 這些會產生敲擊感。其敲擊形態與頻率取決於製造項目——鐵鎚比十字鎬更慢且更沉重——而最後一下敲擊會在製造完成時落下。
